jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking experienced **Senior Embedded Software Engineers** to develop real-time embedded control and application software for advanced rocket propulsion systems. This hands-on role supports the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, integration, and testing.

The ideal candidate has strong **C/C++ development experience**, a background in safety-critical or mission-critical systems, and experience working in hardware-integrated environments. This position offers the opportunity to support laboratory testing and live rocket engine hot-fire tests.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, implement, and test real-time embedded control and application software for propulsion systems.
* Support the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, coding, unit testing, integration, and verification.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation for safety-critical and mission-critical software.
* Participate in software design reviews, customer reviews, and program milestone activities.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to support hardware/software integration and laboratory testing.
* Identify opportunities to improve software development processes, tools, metrics, and overall efficiency.
* Support propulsion system testing, including potential live hot-fire engine tests.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline with 6+ years of relevant experience; or a master's degree with 4+ years; or 10+ years of experience in lieu of a degree.
* **6+ years of embedded real-time software development experience.**
* **6+ years of C/C++ programming experience.**
* Experience developing safety-critical or human-rated software.
* Strong understanding of the full software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, implementation, integration, and testing.
* Experience producing detailed software documentation for mission-critical systems.
* Strong problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills.
* **Active Secret security clearance required at start.**
* **U.S. citizenship required; dual citizenship is not permitted.**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS), including NI Linux, INTEGRITY, Red Hat Linux, or QNX.
* Knowledge of communication protocols such as MIL-STD-1553, TCP/IP, RS-422, and SPI.
* Experience with UML and modeling tools such as Enterprise Architect, Rhapsody, or Cameo.
* Hardware/software integration and embedded systems testing experience.
* Familiarity with laboratory equipment, including oscilloscopes, multimeters, and power supplies.
* Experience with software development IDEs and lifecycle management tools.
* Understanding of CMMI Level 3 or higher software development processes.

**Additional Details**

* **Location:** Huntsville, AL
* **Travel:** Up to 10% to testing facilities in Alabama, Virginia, and California.

60.00 - 69.50 per hour (DOE)

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Job ID: 2618305

**Location:** Huntsville, AL, US

**Date Posted:** 2026-10-23

**Category:** Engineering and Sciences

**Subcategory:** Systems Engineer

**Schedule:** Full-Time

**Shift:** Day Job

**Travel:** Yes - 10% of the time

**Minimum Clearance Required:** Secret

**Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain:** None

**Potential for Remote Work:** ORA\_ON\_SITE

**Description**

﻿SAIC is seeking a mid-level **Senior Systems Engineer** to support the **Common Translator (CT)**, an embedded software module that acts as a translator between existing aircraft software and a new Identification, Friend or Foe (IFF) transponder located in **Huntsville, AL**. In this role, you will lead and support systems engineering activities across the lifecycle of safety-critical avionics software developed under DO-178C (DAL C) objectives.

The ideal candidate will work closely with software and test engineers to translate operational and certification requirements into well-structured system and software requirements, architectures, interfaces, and verification strategies. This position is ideal for an engineer who thrives on rigorous requirements engineering, system architecture, and disciplined verification in a standards-driven aerospace environment.

**The Senior Systems Engineer will be responsible for but not limited to the following duties:**

* Elicit, analyze, and document system-level and software-level requirements for transponder-based capabilities.
* Ensure requirements are clear, consistent, testable, and traceable to customer needs, standards, and DO-178C DAL C objectives.
* Decompose and allocate system requirements to software components and interfaces, maintaining end-to-end traceability from high-level requirements through design and test.
* Manage requirements baselines and changes, performing impact analyses on architecture, design, integration, and verification activities.
* Maintain requirements traceability matrices and support audits and reviews focused on requirements completeness and consistency.
* Develop and refine system and software architectures for CT configurations, including data interfaces, and integration with avionics systems.
* Define and maintain interface control documents (ICDs) and data models for integration with aircraft flight management systems, and other avionics subsystems.
* Collaborate with software engineers to ensure the architecture and requirements support performance, safety, configurability, and maintainability goals.
* Data analysis and testing in customer and/or 3rd-party labs (to include some travel)
* Apply DO-178C and related aerospace standards and guidance to systems engineering and requirements activities.
* Support the development of plans, standards, and guidelines (e.g., requirements standards, architecture guidelines) for CT-based solutions.
* Contribute to compliance evidence by producing and reviewing systems engineering and requirements artifacts required for audits and certification reviews.
* Define and maintain verification and validation strategies, including mapping of system and software requirements to test plans and procedures.
* Develop and review test plans, procedures, and cases, ensuring they provide adequate coverage of requirements and key operational scenarios.
* Support integration and system test activities, including anomaly investigation, root cause analysis, and requirements-focused corrective actions.
* Work closely with test engineers to evaluate test results, confirm requirement satisfaction, and improve test effectiveness and traceability.
* Participate in agile ceremonies (backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily standups, reviews, retrospectives) representing systems and requirements engineering concerns.
* Collaborate with software engineers, test engineers and customer stakeholders to refine features and ensure they meet operational needs and certification constraints.
* Lead or contribute to technical reviews (requirements reviews, architecture/design reviews, test readiness reviews) to ensure quality and compliance.
* Develop and maintain systems engineering documentation, including requirements specifications, architecture descriptions, ICDs, and verification reports.
* Ensure systems engineering and requirements artifacts are properly baselined, controlled, and integrated with configuration management tools and processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve requirements management, architecture practices, and verification workflows, and help implement process and tool enhancements.
* Support customer interactions and technical presentations, clearly communicating requirements rationale, system capabilities, constraints, and trade-offs.

**Qualifications**

**Required Education:**

* Bachelor's degree and five (5) years’ experience; additional four (4) years’ experience can be considered in lieu of degree.

**Required Clearance:**

* Must possess an active Secret security clearance with the ability to maintain; US Citizenship required.

**Required Skills:**

* Experience in requirements engineering: elicitation, analysis, decomposition, allocation, baselining, and traceability.
* Experience developing system and software architectures, defining interfaces, and working with multidisciplinary teams to realize designs.
* Experience collaborating closely with software engineering teams; ability to understand and discuss software design and implementation trade-offs in the context of requirements.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to perform impact analyses and resolve complex integration and requirement issues.
* Proficiency with requirements management practices and tools (e.g., traceability matrices, baseline control, change management).
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing technical documentation and participating in formal reviews.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Technician III
jobs.description:
Description:

TriVector Services, Inc. provides quality aerospace engineering solutions to complex problems through a renowned team of engineering professionals. We are a Service-Disabled, Veteran-Owned, SBA-certified Small Business headquartered in Huntsville, Alabama. Our experienced team is dedicated to building lasting partnerships based on professional integrity and sound engineering principles. TriVector's **Experience** and exceptional **Performance** adds measurable **Value** to every project. TriVector Services, Inc., is seeking qualified candidates to fill our **Electrical Engineering Technician III** position.

The Electrical Engineering Technician level III will support the NASA - Marshall Space Flight Center to provide semi-professional technical support for engineers working in such areas as research, design, development, testing, or manufacturing process improvement. Work pertains to electrical, electronic, or mechanical components or equipment. These technicians are required to have some practical knowledge of science or engineering. Some positions may require a practical knowledge of mathematics or computer science. Included are workers who prepare design drawings and assist with the design, evaluation, and/or modification of machinery and equipment.

The Engineering Technician III performs non-routine assignments of substantial variety and complexity, using operational precedents that are not fully applicable, such assignments that are typically parts of broader assignments, are screened to eliminate unusual design problems. This employee may plan such assignments. This technician receives technical advice from supervisor or engineer. Work is reviewed for technical adequacy (or conformity with instructions). This position may be assisted by lower level technicians and have frequent contact with professionals and others within the establishment, and performs one or a combination of such typical duties as:

* Select or adapt standard procedures, tools, equipment, and techniques using precedents that may not be fully applicable to the assignment.
* Perform unique assignments of substantial variety and scope as part of larger engineering, test, development, integration, or operations programs.
* Manage multiple tasks with guidance from Contract leadership regarding technical performance, task assignments, and prioritization based on direction from NASA Branch management.
* Conduct activities requiring safety certifications in coordination with Branch management, technical leads, or designated senior engineering personnel.
* Perform electrical assembly, installation, integration, checkout, and troubleshooting activities for engineering, test, and operational flight hardware systems.
* Conduct testing activities requiring the selection, adaptation, or modification of test equipment, instrumentation, controls, and procedures.
* Install, configure, operate, and maintain instrumentation, data acquisition systems, monitoring equipment, and associated support hardware used for engineering and test operations.
* Operate and maintain electrical, electronic, and instrumentation equipment used in laboratory, fabrication, integration, and test environments.
* Perform verification, calibration, maintenance, and functional checkout of instrumentation, sensors, measurement systems, and associated support equipment.
* Perform data collection, monitoring, and analysis activities using a variety of electronic, digital, and computer-based systems.
* Execute engineering and test operations using standard and specialized instrumentation, control systems, power distribution equipment, and data acquisition platforms.
* Fabricate, route, terminate, label, inspect, and test electrical wiring, harnesses, cables, and connectors in accordance with engineering documentation and industry standards.
* Interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, assembly drawings, and engineering documentation to support fabrication, integration, troubleshooting, and test activities.
* Assemble, integrate, and verify electrical and electromechanical hardware, subsystems, and support equipment to meet engineering and operational requirements.
* Support installation, integration, checkout, troubleshooting, and modification of flight hardware, developmental systems, prototype hardware, and ground support equipment.
* Perform continuity, insulation resistance, circuit verification, and functional testing of electrical systems and assemblies.
* Assist with configuration control activities, including hardware identification, documentation updates, and verification of installed configurations.
* Support anomaly resolution and failure investigations through inspection, troubleshooting, testing, data collection, and corrective action implementation.
* Obtain and maintain all certifications required to support assigned duties, including operation of material handling equipment, personnel lifts, and other specialized equipment as required by the scope of work.
* Perform assignments that are not completely standardized or prescribed.

Requirements:

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* U.S. Citizenship is required.
* Must have at least 3 years of relevant experience.
* Requires ability to obtain and maintain NASA Public Trust background screening requirements.
* Practical knowledge of science or engineering is required.
* Practical knowledge of mathematics is required.
* Must have at least a high school diploma or GED.
* Must be able to work from written and verbal instructions.
* Must adhere to MSFC and OSHA safety requirements, including use of appropriate PPE when necessary and follow written technical procedures.
* Must be dependable and willing to work hours outside the normal schedule.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and workmanship.
* Must be able to pass a MSFC physical examination for any required safety-related certifications.
* Must be able to lift 40lbs with or without reasonable accommodation.
* Good communicatio

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer -Top SECRET - ONSITE
jobs.description:
Visual Soft, Inc is seeking qualified candidates (US Citizens with active **TOP SECRET** clearance - a requirement on its Project with a Major Prime) for the following position for a federal agency.

**Job Title**: Senior Systems Engineer  
**Location**: Huntsville, AL  
**Salary**: based on experience on other qualifications. OR 1099 is also available only for individuals NOT C2C scenario, check will be issued in legal name
  
**Clearance**: **TOP SECRET is** a must and job is fully ONSITE  
**Education:** Bachelor's degree with 8+ years of experience  
**Job description:**  
We are seeking an experienced **Senior Systems Engineer** with following job responsibilities **:**

* Supervise, coordinate and/or perform additions and changes to network hardware and operating systems, and attached devices, including investigation, analysis, recommendation, configuration, installation, and testing of new network hardware and software.
* Provide direct support in the day-to-day operations on network hardware and operating systems including the evaluation of system utilization, monitoring response time and primary support for detection and correction of operational problems.
* Troubleshoot at the physical level of the network, working with network measurement hardware and software, as well as physical checking and testing of hardware devices at the logical level working with communication protocols.
* Participate in planning design, technical review and implementation for new network infrastructure hardware and network operating systems for voice and data communication networks.
* Perform systems management and integration functions. Exhibiting proficiency with virtualization technologies and network administration.
* Maintain network infrastructure standards including network communication protocols such as TCP/IP. Provide technical consultation, training and support to IT staff as designated by the government.
* Diagnose and resolve complex communication problems.
* Perform systems management and integration functions.
* Responsible for design, deployment, evaluating, testing, certification, patching, addressing interoperability issues, not only of the base storage & backup system, but for all features, components, and application dependencies.
* Ensures systems are current with approved patches and assists with certification and system accreditation tasks, composes SOPs, and Quick Reference guides for users.

**Standard benefits**: Our standard benefits include: **Our standard benefits** include 3 weeks of Paid time off (PTO that includes sick leave). Any unused PTO will be issued as a check at the end of an employee's anniversary with us. we also provide 2 floating and 8 public holidays. Floating and holidays expire at the end of every year of service of an employee. In addition, company will cover 50% of health and dental insurances only for all full time employees, however, dependents can be added at extra cost. Employee's health and dental coverage becomes effective after 30 days or first of the month after an employee completes initial 30 working days, we cover 50% for the employee's health and dental insurances. An employee has to finish all of your paper work for health and dental in the first 30 days of your employment with us. We provide STD, LTD and one time salary equivalent of life insurance at NO cost to all full time employees. All full time employees or w-2 employees with no benefits will be eligible to participate in company's 401k program after 90 days of employment with a company match of 4%, immediate vesting. In addition, all w-2 employees are eligible to be part of company's profit sharing, no employee contributions required.

Advance how our customers operate while you advance your career. Join GDIT as a Systems Engineer Senior and build an impactful career in enterprise IT, collaborating with people who are driven and resourceful like you.

As a Systems Engineer Senior, the work you’ll do at GDIT will be impactful to the mission to provide sustaining engineering and product lifecycle management support for multiple Force Protection System (FPS) Family of Systems (FOS) to the IBD-SS II program.

  
  

You will play a crucial role in execute planning, design, and implementation of system engineering projects, by providing clear technical direction to team members and have breadth of knowledge as it pertains to systems integration and design.

Drive key outcomes by assisting in the analysis of failed products to improve sustainment support through viable solutions to include but not limited too

* Review baseline designs for errors and failure points.

* Execute Level of Repair Analysis for systems end to end.

* Develop Engineering BOMs from Technical Data Packages

* Attend Engineering Review Boards for engineering change requests and prepare documents for CCB

* Brief Engineering Change Proposals to CCB

* Development of engineering test plans and reports

* Address obsolescence issues and concerns working in conjunction with the IBD-SS logistics team

* Interface with other engineers, SMEs, and technicians to solve equipment malfunctions and design flaws

* Manage the full life cycle of systems with a focus on sustainment engineering.

* Support existing systems by researching, reviewing design, assisting procurement, cataloging, installing, and conducting maintenance of FP Systems.

Bring your technology expertise and drive for innovation to GDIT. The Systems Engineer Senior must have:

* Education: Bachelor of Arts/Bachelor of Science (years of experience will be considered in lieu of a degree)

* Experience: 5+ years of related experience
* Security clearance level: US Secret security clearance required day one; required to maintain secret clearance to remain on contract

* Role requirements: This position is onsite 100% in Huntsville, AL, travel maybe required to support the mission up to 50% both CONUS and OCONUS contingent on mission requirements and could change based on customer requirements and the ability to support all other requirements based on the mission and the scope of the position
  

  

Specific tools, skills or technologies desired in this system engineering sustainment role include but are not limited to:

* QA/QC experience as it relates to Physical Configuration Audits

* Understanding of the full scope of the engineering lifecycle from concept to divestment

* Experience translating an Engineering BOM into a Service BOM for logistics

* Experience with DoD Systems, Engineering requirements and DoD contracts

* Superior technical writing skills, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Field Bulletins, Maintenance plan

* Experience preparing Engineering Change Proposals (ECP) and Technical Data Packages (TDP)

* Experience conducting Level of Repair Analysis (LORA) for commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) products

* Previous experience with Rapiscan and FLIR product lines, DoW Force Protection, Networking and computer technology, hydraulics, electronics, mechanical, camera technologies and supporting software.

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Principal Electrical Engineer 3 – Automated Test Equipment (ATE)

Northrop Grumman Space Systems is currently seeking an experienced Principal Electrical Engineer to join our electrical ground support equipment group in our Chandler, AZ facility. The Automated Test Equipment (ATE) team supports our programs with the design, test, and sustainment of all ATE and test support equipment hardware used in the integration and launch of our vehicles. Our EGSE team members work in a diverse set of roles across the lifecycle of a program.

Job Duties: Based on specific objectives, work with a system electrical engineering team to perform analysis, design, and test of complex “system level” designs with a focus on the electrical ground support equipment and test support equipment for the launch vehicle.

Job responsibilities:

  

* Broad understanding and application of company electrical engineering technical standards.
* Broad technical expertise and working knowledge of other related disciplines.
* Prepares and presents electrical engineering materials for Requirements and Design Reviews.

**Position Purpose & Focus**

The **Senior Systems Engineer** leads the definition of system architecture, interface standards, and product requirements for Phillips Connect's connected trailer and fleet telematics products. Operating at the PM4 Senior Professional level, this role's core focus is the launch of new product lines from concept to mass production. The Senior Systems Engineer owns embedded system and IoT device-to-cloud architecture across multiple product platforms, harmonizes interfaces across current and future designs, serves as a technical knowledge resource across functions, and mentors Systems Engineers.

This position partners closely with Hardware Engineering, Firmware Engineering, Test Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Product Management, Manufacturing, and the Commercial team to ensure Phillips Connect systems are scalable, reliable, testable, and aligned with customer and business needs.

**Expected Results**

* System architectures and interface standards that scale across multiple product platforms
* Complete, prioritized product requirements that enable on-schedule launch of new product lines from concept to mass production
* Harmonized interfaces across current and future designs that reduce development and validation time
* Vendor-ready protocol library specifications with clear release testing requirements
* System-level verification and validation strategies that reduce field issues and release risk
* Effective cross-functional alignment and development of Systems Engineers through mentoring

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**
=======================================

* **System Architecture Leadership**

* Lead the definition of system and software architectures for embedded platforms across multiple product lines.
* Define the partitioning of functions across MCUs, hardware, firmware, and cloud systems, including the roles and responsibilities of each MCU.
* Lead system architecture and interface reviews, and make trade-off decisions balancing performance, power, cost, reliability, and schedule.
* Verify that architectures and interfaces meet timing, throughput, and frame/packet size requirements for all use cases.

* **Interface Standards & Harmonization**

* Establish standardized microprocessor interfaces and interconnects between printed circuit board assemblies.
* Update existing interfaces to harmonize current and future designs, leveraging reusable design components to speed development.
* Own protocol library requirements and the release testing requirements for libraries distributed to vendors.

* **Requirements Leadership**

* Lead the translation of commercial requirements into firmware and system product requirements for new product lines from concept to mass production.
* Define and propose algorithms based on commercial requirements, and resolve requirement conflicts across functions.
* Establish requirements traceability from commercial needs through design, verification, and release.

* **IoT & Connectivity Architecture**

* Lead the definition of IoT device-to-cloud protocols, data payloads, and client/server interfaces in partnership with Cloud Engineering.
* Ensure device-to-cloud interfaces are secure, efficient, scalable, and supportable across product generations.

* **Verification & Validation Strategy**

* Define system-level verification and validation strategies, monitoring and test interfaces, and release criteria for firmware features.
* Lead system-level root cause analysis of complex integration and field issues with Firmware, Hardware, Test Engineering, and Technical Support.

* **Technical Leadership & Continuous Improvement**

* Mentor and develop Systems Engineers, and serve as a technical knowledge resource for Firmware and Hardware Engineering.
* Facilitate communication to align design teams on standard interfaces, and present concise technical recommendations to engineering leadership.
* Recommend and implement improvements to systems engineering processes, documentation standards, and tools, and publish and archive technical requirements and analysis.

*The above is intended to describe the general content of and the requirements for the performance of this position. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements.*

================================================

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field required.
* Master's degree is preferred.

**Experience**

* 5–8+ years of systems engineering experience, including hardware and software design and development.
* Demonstrated experience defining system architecture and requirements for commercial embedded products from concept through production.
* Experience leading interface standardization or architecture efforts across multiple products or platforms.
* Experience mentoring engineers and leading cross-functional technical initiatives.
* Experience with telematics, IoT, connected vehicle, or industrial embedded systems preferred.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Advanced system architecture and design for embedded platforms
* Requirements engineering, traceability, and requirements management practices
* Embedded communication interfaces (UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, CAN/J1939, EIA-485)
* IoT device-to-cloud protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, MQTT), data payload design, and secure networking fundamentals

jobs.title: Embedded Systems Engineer, Robotics
jobs.description:
**ABOUT DEXMATE**

Dexmate is building the foundation for physical AI — combining a new generation of robots with a universal Physical AI OS, making robots as easy to build and deploy as software. Today, robotics is fragmented, slow, and closed: most builders are forced to reinvent the same stack again and again, and most ideas never make it past the prototype stage. We exist to change that. Our mission is to democratize robotics by lowering the barrier to entry, delivering a plug-and-play platform for developers, researchers, and enterprises, and cultivating an open ecosystem that accelerates the evolution of physical AI.

If you want to help shape the next layer of human capability — and believe the future of robotics should be built together, not in isolation — we'd love to build it with you.

**THE ROLE**

We're looking for an Embedded Systems Engineer to own the boundary where our robot's electronics meet its software. You will bring up and debug new PCBs, write the firmware and drivers that make every sensor, camera, actuator, and compute module talk to each other, and make sure data moves reliably across CAN/CAN FD, EtherCAT, GMSL, I2C, SPI, and Ethernet.

This is a hands-on, cross-layer role. One day you're probing a board with a scope to find why a bus is dropping frames; the next you're writing a Linux driver for a camera serializer or tuning an EtherCAT network for deterministic timing. You'll work closely with electrical, firmware, controls, and robotics software engineers, and you'll often be the person who figures out whether a problem lives in hardware, firmware, or software.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Bringing up, validating, and debugging new PCBs: reading schematics and layouts, measuring signals, and isolating hardware vs. software faults
* Developing firmware for MCUs (bare-metal and RTOS) and drivers for embedded Linux platforms (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson / Orin)
* Writing and maintaining device drivers and communication stacks for CAN/CAN FD, EtherCAT, I2C, SPI, UART, and Ethernet
* Integrating camera and sensor pipelines over GMSL (serializer/deserializer configuration, device trees, V4L2 drivers, timing and synchronization)
* Bringing up and tuning EtherCAT and CAN networks across actuators, sensors, and power systems for deterministic, real-time performance
* Debugging signal-integrity, power, timing, and bus-level issues with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers
* Contributing firmware and software input during schematic and PCB design reviews to make boards easier to bring up, test, and debug
* Building diagnostics, test fixtures, and automated hardware-in-the-loop tests for boards and subsystems
* Supporting manufacturing, end-of-line testing, and field troubleshooting as robots move from prototype to deployment
* Documenting interfaces, bring-up procedures, and debugging playbooks for the wider team

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* 3+ years of professional experience in embedded systems in robotics, automotive, industrial automation, or complex consumer electronics
* Strong C and C++ skills for firmware and driver development; working knowledge of Python for tooling and test automation
* Hands-on board bring-up experience, including reading schematics, PCB layouts, datasheets, and timing diagrams
* Driver-level experience with several of: CAN/CAN FD, EtherCAT, I2C, SPI, UART, Ethernet
* Experience with MCU firmware (ARM Cortex-M, STM32, TI C2000, or similar) on bare-metal or RTOS platforms
* Comfort with embedded debugging and lab tools: JTAG/SWD debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers
* Systematic debugging skills across the hardware, firmware, and software boundary
* Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with electrical, mechanical, controls, and software engineers

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

jobs.title: Sr Embedded Engineer, Vehicle Diagnostics and Monitoring
jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
  
Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We're building out a high-velocity team of multi-disciplinary experts to turn real-world operations into high-quality data for our autonomous partners. This team is focused on the hardest problem in AV today: unlocking real-world, long-tail driving data. Autonomy is now a data race—and Uber has an edge: We collect rare, real-world driving data at a scale and capital efficiency no one else can match.  
  
Our AV Labs Hardware team is building the next-generation E/E architecture for our L4 data-collection vehicle fleet. A fleet only collects useful data when its compute, MCU and sensors work reliably in the car, and when a fault can be found and fixed without a technician on site. You will build the diagnostics, monitoring and dashboards that make fleet health visible, from MCU and SoC firmware to fleet dashboards, and you will bring our hardware to life in vehicles and support the path to production-line testing.  
  
**What the Candidate Will Do**  

* **Diagnostics and fault management:** Design and implement fault detection, event and DTC handling, UDS and DoIP services, and watchdog supervision across the MCU and the Linux compute platform.
* **Monitoring framework:** Design and own the vehicle health monitoring pipeline: collect metrics, logs and fault events from the MCU (CAN, serial or UDP) and the Linux SoC, and send them to a central time-series and log store using standard tooling (for example Prometheus exporters or OpenTelemetry collectors).
* **Deep system observability:** Use eBPF and kernel tracing to observe Linux SoC behavior with low overhead: scheduling, network, driver and camera pipeline latency, and frame or packet drops.
* **Dashboards and alerting:** Build dashboards (for example in Grafana) for fleet, vehicle and board health: temperatures, voltages, power state, bus load, time sync offset, camera link status and update status. Define alert rules and thresholds, and route alerts to on-call.
* **Vehicle bring-up and integration:** Commission the compute, MCU and sensor stack in vehicles (CAN-FD, Ethernet, power sequencing, GNSS, IMU, cameras) and validate gPTP and PPS timing.
* **Field triage and test automation:** Use monitoring data to reproduce and root-cause vehicle issues with the reliability and software teams, and turn each one into an automated regression test and, where useful, a new dashboard panel or alert.
* **Safety and security of diagnostics:** Contribute to safety analysis (FMEA, FMEDA) and implement safety mechanisms. Protect diagnostic access with authenticated sessions and security access.
* **Production line support:** Define the diagnostic interfaces and readouts (unit identity, firmware versions, pass or fail data) that end-of-line test stations use, with the manufacturing test team.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* **Embedded experience:** Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, with 7+ years developing embedded software in C/C++ on an RTOS, embedded Linux or bare metal.
* **Automotive diagnostics:** Hands-on experience with UDS (ISO 14229), DTC handling and ISO-TP over CAN; DoIP (ISO 13400) is a plus.
* **Vehicle networks and integration:** Strong experience with CAN/CAN-FD and Automotive Ethernet, tools such as Vector CANoe or similar, oscilloscopes and logic analyzers, and integrating compute platforms and sensors in vehicles.
* **Linux observability:** Hands-on experience debugging system-level issues on embedded Linux with eBPF-based tools and profilers (for example bpftrace, bcc or perf).
* **Monitoring and visualization:** Experience building monitoring for devices or fleets (for example with Prometheus and Grafana): instrumentation or exporters, dashboards and alert rules, in Python, Go or C/C++.
* **Production lifecycle:** Experience taking embedded systems from prototype and third-party integration to production, ideally in autonomous vehicle, robotics or mission-critical automotive domains.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* **Observability stack:** Experience with log and time-series stacks (for example Loki, ELK, OpenTelemetry, InfluxDB), eBPF-based observability tools, and fleet-scale telemetry pipelines (retention, cardinality, cost).
* **Security:** Hardware security module (HSM) and secure boot experience, plus secure diagnostics (UDS security access, authenticated sessions, key management).
* **AUTOSAR diagnostics:** Configuring Dcm, Dem, FiM, WdgM and E2E modules in an AUTOSAR Classic stack.
* **Functional safety:** ISO 26262 (ASIL B through D), ASPICE and MISRA C/C++.
* **Production and service tooling:** End-of-line test, factory programming or remote service diagnostics tooling.
* **Linux and AV compute:** Linux kernel, device tree and Yocto board support, and experience with platforms such as NVIDIA DRIVE or Jetson.

  
For Sunnyvale, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $180,000 per year - USD $200,000 per year.  
  
You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

Xona is the navigational intelligence company bringing real-time, centimeter-level certainty to any device, anywhere on Earth.

With Pulsar – the world’s most advanced PNT satellite infrastructure in Low Earth Orbit – Xona will offer a future-proof, backwards-compatible global positioning system optimized for absolute precision, superior power, and robust protection.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an **Electrical Engineer** to join our satellite development team. In this role, you will design, develop, and integrate electrical systems that power and control spacecraft propulsion systems, working closely with engineers from other subsystems to integrate your designs from concept through flight.

This is a hands-on, collaborative role where you’ll lead electrical hardware design, lab testing, and debugging across low-to-high voltage subsystems. This includes embedded microcontroller hardware, power tree design, precision sensor acquisition, valve drivers, and dedicated DC/DC converters. You will work alongside firmware and power electronics engineers and collaborate closely with propulsion and avionics teams to ensure hardware reliability in harsh space environments.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Hardware Design:** Design and develop electrical subsystems for propulsion electronics, including embedded microcontroller hardware, sensor interfaces, valve drivers, and power conversion.
* **PCB Development:** Lead schematic capture and multi-layer PCB layout design from breadboard prototypes to flight hardware.
* **Power & Driver Stages:** Design, tune, and validate DC/DC converters and driver stages for inductive and resistive loads.
* **Analog Acquisition:** Implement precision analog front-ends for critical telemetry, including current sensing (high-side/low-side), pressure transducers, and temperature monitoring.
* **Firmware Collaboration:** Collaborate closely with embedded firmware engineers to define hardware/firmware interfaces, peripheral pin mappings, register maps, and communication protocols (CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, RS-422).
* **Reviews & Quality:** Conduct hardware design and layout reviews. Support component sourcing while ensuring compliance with standards and derating guidelines.
* **Testing & Automation:** Develop and execute electrical test plans from breadboard to flight hardware, writing Python scripts for test automation and data logging.
* **Lab Debugging:** Troubleshoot and debug electrical systems in a lab environment using test equipment (e.g., oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, electronic dynamic loads, power meters).
* **Documentation:** Develop electrical interface documentation (ICDs) and test procedures for spacecraft subsystems.
* **Integration Support:** Support assembly, integration, and test (AIT) activities, including environmental testing (e.g., TVAC, vibration, EMI/EMC).

**Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 2+ years taking mixed-signal designs from schematics to manufacturing and lab bring-up.
* **EDA & Modeling:** Familiarity with electrical design and simulation tools (e.g., Altium, KiCad, SPICE).
* **Core Technical:** Fundamental understanding of mixed-signal electronics, power tree design, power conversion, signal integrity, and hardware reliability in harsh space environments.
* **Embedded HW:** Hands-on experience designing embedded microcontroller hardware and peripheral interfaces (CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, RS-422).
* **Power Electronics:** Experience designing driver circuits for inductive loads (valves, valve drivers, solenoids) and closed-loop DC/DC converters. High-voltage power electronics experience is a plus.
* **Analog Design:** Strong background in precision sensor acquisition and analog signal conditioning (op-amps, filtering, ADC/DAC interfacing).
* **Lab Validation:** Hands-on experience with electrical testing, debugging (oscilloscopes, dynamic loads, power meters), and Python test scripting.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to satellite systems, avionics, or electrical power systems.
* Experience with space environmental testing (e.g., TVAC, vibration, EMI/EMC per MIL-STD-461) and component derating standards (e.g., NASA EEE-INST-002).
* Experience developing hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulators
* Familiarity with reading embedded C/C++ to collaborate seamlessly with firmware engineers during low-level driver bring-up and boundary-scan debugging.

**For U.S. Roles:** To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States (i.e. Green Card holder), or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

**For U.K. Roles:** To comply with U.K. regulations, this role requires Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) checks, and successful candidates must be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC).

jobs.description:
### **About Us**

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in.

### **Available Locations: Austin, TX | New York, NY | San Francisco, CA | Seattle, WA | London, UK**

### **About the Role**

Cloudflare's Developer Platform powers stateful, data-intensive applications across our network. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work across the database stack, from query planning and execution to transaction processing and durable storage.

You'll make decisions that shape the consistency, durability, and latency guarantees that customer applications rely on.

Correctness under concurrency and failure is central to the role. You'll define and implement how queries read and modify data, how concurrent transactions become visible, and how durable state is recovered. You'll validate these systems using deterministic simulation, workload testing, and evidence from production.

### **Responsibilities**

* Improve query planning and execution, including index selection, row reads and writes, and performance as data volumes and access patterns change.
* Build transaction and storage paths that make writes durable and reads consistent. Define when changes become visible, how commits survive failure, and how recovery restores a correct view of the data.
* Design deterministic simulations that make rare event orderings and failures reproducible.
* Plan stateful upgrades that cannot be reversed by rolling back software. Carry them through staged rollout, failover, and recovery without putting existing data at risk.
* Participate in the service's on-call rotation and incident response.
* Own major changes from design through production. Coordinate implementation across teams when a change spans multiple parts of the service, and help trace failures across those parts.
* Mentor other engineers through design reviews, debugging, and incident analysis involving concurrency, durability, and recovery.

### **Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience**

* You have owned a database, storage engine, transaction system, or similarly correctness-sensitive stateful system from architecture through production. You can make architecture and implementation decisions when requirements or system boundaries are incomplete.
* You understand how query execution, indexing, transaction processing, and durable state shape what developers and operators observe.
* You understand how concurrency control, isolation, replication, and snapshots shape consistency, durability, and recovery. You can apply those concepts when operations arrive out of order, components fail independently, or the network partitions.
* You write and debug concurrent production software in Rust, Go, C++, or another systems language. You can trace failures across process, network, and durable-state boundaries.
* You have operated stateful systems through rollouts, scaling events, incidents, and recovery. You know the difference between transient unavailability and incomplete or incorrect recovery, and when a system is safe to return to service.
* You have led investigations where failures crossed systems owned by several teams.

### **Bonus Points**

* You've worked on the internals of PostgreSQL, MySQL, Amazon Aurora, or another relational database and can trace a SQL operation from planning through commit.
* Your work on transaction processing or concurrency control has included defining snapshot visibility and recovery behavior.
* You've profiled database workloads and traced performance bottlenecks from query execution through durable storage.
* You've used deterministic simulation or another systematic method to uncover distributed-systems bugs that conventional tests missed.

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

* For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $194,000 - $266,000
* For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. **Varda's W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.**

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

**About This Role**
-------------------

The **Senior Mission Software Engineer** is responsible for Varda's critical ground segment software, and the platform it runs on which enables spacecraft operations. We operate at the intersection of telemetry and commanding, data acquisition and distribution, mission control interfaces, simulation and test automation, with reliable deployment across lab, test range, and mission operations environments. Standardize CI/CD pipelines, artifact management, service templates, infrastructure-as-code, simulation and hardware-in-the-loop frameworks, test harnesses, and observability - all delivered as self-service tooling.

* 5+ years of experience in the development of spacecraft or similar safety critical software.
* Expertise with development in Python, along with a strong understanding of the language concepts.
* Have strong systems fundamentals: concurrency, networking, performance, reliability.
* Experience building real-time data acquisition, scaling, and distribution services - low-latency messaging, time-series and relational stores.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD, dependency/build systems, and infrastructure-as-code.
* End-to-end observability experience: logging, metrics, tracing.
* Docker/Kubernetes; release management, phased rollouts, and operational readiness for controlled networks.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**
-----------------------------------

* Proficiency in C++, Ansible, and/or NiceGUI.
* Experience with DAQ and closed-loop control (lab/test control environments).
* Prior work on CI/testing/simulation/data tools integrated with flight software teams.
* Experience with requirements, test, and certification artifacts from safety-critical or certified workflows.
* Knowledge of ground systems standards; security in mission networks.
* Experience building mission-grade UIs with structured command workflows, alarming, and situational awareness.

**Pay Range**

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager, AI Kernels & Performance Optimization — MTIA Software
jobs.description:
Meta designs and deploys its own AI systems. MTIA — the Meta Training and Inference Accelerator — is Meta's family of in-house AI accelerator ASICs, running recommendation and ranking workloads in production across Meta's data centers today and expanding into generative AI inference and training as successive silicon generations land.The MTIA Software team is part of the AI & Compute Foundation (ACF) organization within Meta Infrastructure. We build the entire stack a chip vendor would normally supply — compiler and LLVM toolchain, runtime, kernel authoring frameworks and libraries, developer tooling, and deep PyTorch integration — co-designing it with the silicon teams generation over generation.Within that stack, the AI Kernels and Performance Optimization team (KORE) owns the layer where silicon architecture meets arithmetic. Our mission is roofline-level performance and programmability at scale: we design and implement high-performance compute and communication kernels (GEMM, attention variants, normalization, collectives, elementwise and reduction fusions, sparse and quantized paths) against novel architectural features including matrix engines, on-chip reduction fabrics, and software-managed memory hierarchies. We ship kernel libraries with broad PyTorch operator coverage, build C++ and Python kernel authoring frameworks and DSL surfaces, and write production kernels against new architectures long before first silicon — turning hardware proposals into measured roofline evidence while the design can still change.We are seeking a Software Engineering Manager to lead a team of kernel and performance engineers doing this work. You will own the performance of workloads that serve billions of people, drive technical strategy for kernel development and optimization, and build a team that can deliver roofline-level performance on MTIA accelerators. Your team will profile and root-cause performance across the full stack — instruction scheduling, memory hierarchy and DMA behavior, on-chip interconnect, multi-device collectives — and drive fixes to the right layer, whether that is the kernel, compiler, runtime, or hardware. You will partner closely with silicon architecture teams on hardware/software co-design, quantifying the value of proposed features with real kernels and advocating for the changes the software stack needs. This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you will contribute directly to architectural decisions while enabling your team to move with speed and clarity.  
  
  

### **Software Engineering Manager, AI Kernels & Performance Optimization — MTIA Software Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage a team of systems engineers delivering on multiple concurrent projects across ambiguous, high-impact areas of Meta's platform infrastructure
* Drive roadmap creation and technical strategy for systems-level software, ensuring alignment with broader product and engineering goals
* Contribute directly to technical work including architecture reviews, design documents, and hands-on coding to maintain credibility and unblock the team
* Identify and resolve systemic issues affecting team velocity, including on-call load, technical debt, and gaps in tooling or automation
* Partner with product, design, and data science to ensure engineers contribute across disciplines and deliver outcomes that move business metrics forward
* Set clear goals and expectations for individual engineers, provide timely and actionable feedback, and proactively address performance gaps
* Manage staged rollouts and feature delivery using feature flagging and A/B testing frameworks, ensuring high engineering quality and system reliability
* Recruit, onboard, and develop engineers, building a team structure that minimizes single points of failure and scales with organizational needs
* Communicate team goals, technical decisions, and progress clearly to cross-functional partners and leadership, including written design proposals and postmortems
* Participate in org-wide engineering contributions, sharing effective workflows, tooling practices, and systems engineering patterns across the broader organization

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

jobs.title: Senior Spacecraft Systems Engineer, Avionics
jobs.description:
**About Varda**
---------------

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. **Varda's W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.**

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

**About This Role**
-------------------

The **Senior Spacecraft Systems Engineer, Avionics** oversees the design, integration, and testing of avionics systems for our Winnebago Spaceship. They ensure that all systems are ready for both launch and operational phases, requiring a deep understanding of avionics system design, manufacturing processes, and operational protocols. They closely collaborate with various engineering teams and navigate conflicting requirements to achieve seamless system integration. Their expertise will be crucial in ensuring the vehicle meets its mission objectives, from space manufacturing to hypersonic testing during reentry.

### **Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with cross functional teams to define project scopes and initial requirements, guiding designs from concept to prototype and full-scale production.
* Develop electrical architecture, system diagrams, and budgets to account for power, telemetry, channel count, size, and mass predictions used to communicate closing vehicle solutions to company level objectives.
* Analyze architecture for potential faults and risks, develop comprehensive mitigation plans, resolve uncertainties, and collaborate on Fault Detection Isolation and Recovery (FDIR) or operational workarounds when hardware solutions are unfeasible.
* Conduct comprehensive verification plans for avionics systems on flight and HITL hardware, ensuring readiness for launch and compliance with mission objectives for space and reentry operations.
* Participate in mission operations as an Avionics specialist or system operator, where they'll determine system health, suggest corrective actions to reentry commit criteria for operational success.
* Oversee the integration of the Winnebago avionics systems, acting as the primary point of contact for integrated systems investigations.
* Design, build, and operate the Hardware In The Loop (HITL) testbeds, simulating the spacecraft on the ground to ensure all systems are mission ready.
* Develop avionics ground infrastructure, support the design and integration of test racks and R&D equipment used to power and communicate with the flight vehicles. Contribute to developing engineering best practices, focusing on increased test automation and efficiency.
* Draw from their experiences to help mentor and train new engineers, fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement within the team.

### **Basic Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field.
* Experience: 5+ years of experience in system design, test planning, and validation.
* Programming Skills: Proficiency in programming and debugging with Python.
* Technical Expertise: Experience with power supplies, modular DAQ systems, RTD and 4-20mA devices, and general test equipment.

### **Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Proven experience taking vehicle electrical systems from concept to operational production.
* Prior experience setting up HITL testbeds, managing configuration control, and conducting system level tests.
* Familiarity with Unix environments and the ability to use command line utilities.
* Experience developing test cases and test equipment to meet vehicle operating conditions.
* Strong project or program management skills.
* Relevant prior roles: Avionics Hardware, FPGA Engineer, Electronics Test Engineer, Electrical Systems Engineer

### **Pay Range**

* Salary range: Senior: $140,333 - $202,703/ per year
* This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA
* Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance
* You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards

**ITAR Requirements**
---------------------

Varda, like all employers, must ensure that its employees working in the United States are lawfully authorized to work in the U.S. Additionally, our employees are exposed to and have access to certain export-controlled items. Because our employees are provided access to export-controlled items, our policy is to only hire "U.S. persons" who are permitted to have access to our technology without an export license.  
  
"US person" means: U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) (i.e., individual admitted to the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum).

  

**E-Verify Statement**
----------------------

Varda Spac

jobs.description:
**About the Implementation Department**

The Investment Implementation department is a community of diverse investment professionals whose mission is to implement our investment strategies and client portfolios excellently. Our Department is responsible for ensuring the excellent implementation of our systematic investment approach, from raw data to executed trades, with processes and logic that reflect the full richness of our investment insight, executed with a near-zero error rate, and engineered and orchestrated in a way that facilitates oversight and compounding. This is an investment department, owning the investment outcomes, and the mandate includes both the ‘run’ responsibility and the ‘transform’ responsibility, meaning daily operations as well as over time renovation of our systems.

We fulfill our mission by applying four operating principles:

* **Understand and deliver internal client needs.** Partner with our internal clients to understand, offer implementation designs, and deliver solutions, while proactively educating and communicating outcomes to ACLs (Asset Class Leads) and CIOs.
* **Own our investment intent.** Own our investment intent in full, in letter and spirit.
* **Continuously improve.** Have and evolve an investment pipeline to meet current and future internal client needs.
* **Systematically and relentlessly deliver quality outcomes.** Apply our best logic systematically, discipline, expertise, and controls to every signal, position, and trade in every market.

**About Your Role**

We are an Engineering owned and led organization which strives to balance independence with incredible community support in an environment that is intellectually vibrant and driven to make a mark on the world as a collaborative force. As a Portfolio Systems Engineer on the Portfolio Implementation team, your mission is to design, build, and evolve the complex, large-scale systems that manage money at the size and scale Bridgewater does — from Risk Controls through to Trade Generation. You will spend your time architecting and industrializing the investment systems that run our portfolios and investment strategies. The Portfolio Systems Engineer will be embedded within the Portfolio Implementation Team and gain a key understanding of our portfolio construction logic, process, and systems.

jobs.title: Advisor, Automation Engineering
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
We are seeking an Indianapolis-based senior automation engineer to join the Automation Engineering team within Lilly's RNA Therapeutics group.
  
  
In this role, the successful candidate will do the core technical work of building, deploying, and supporting laboratory automation that advances pipeline-facing science, with a particular focus on in vitro pharmacology and chemistry workflows. Equally important is the partnership side of the role: working closely with scientific users to understand their needs, supporting the systems they depend on, and enabling teams to get the most out of automation. This is a builder's role for someone who wants to be close to the bench and the instruments, and who takes satisfaction in seeing their systems genuinely adopted.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a skilled automation engineer who independently identifies the key technical problems in a workflow and develops practical solutions to solve them. They take pride in delivering systems that are intuitive and dependable for users with varying levels of automation experience, so that automation measurably improves the efficiency of their work. They bring sound engineering judgment, a methodical approach to qualification and reproducibility, a teamwork-minded approach to user support, and an interest in how emerging tools, including LLM-based coding assistants, can speed up method development and deployment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Build, program, deploy, and maintain laboratory automation systems supporting in vitro pharmacology, chemistry, and related pipeline workflows
* Develop and validate automated methods, translating scientific protocols into robust, reproducible automated processes
* Partner directly with scientific users to gather requirements, understand their workflows, weigh practical tradeoffs, and deliver automation solutions that meet their needs
* Deploy and support automation systems tailored to specific pipeline processes and throughput needs
* Provide ongoing support for deployed systems, responding to user needs and keeping automation running reliably day to day
* Develop clear documentation, quick-reference guides, and ongoing support resources that help teams operate automated workflows independently
* Plan and deliver hands-on training to local end users on new instrumentation, automated methods, and protocols, tailoring instruction to varying levels of automation experience and ensuring users can operate systems confidently and independently
* Resolve hardware, software, and integration issues to keep systems running reliably
* Strengthen data reproducibility across automated processes through sound standards, controls, and qualification practices
* Integrate automation with scheduling and lab orchestration software and with ELN/LIMS platforms such as Benchling
* Apply LLM-based coding tools and agentic assistants to accelerate method development, scripting, and systems integration
* Contribute to the generation of large-scale, structured datasets suitable for AI/ML applications
* Build effective working relationships across scientific and engineering teams to ensure automation solutions fit real-world use

**Basic Qualifications:**  
Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, biological sciences, or related field with 5+ years of hands-on laboratory automation experience.
  
  
**Additional Skills/Preferences:**  

* Hands-on expertise with the Hamilton automation ecosystem and a track record of building and deploying integrated automation across other platforms (e.g. acoustic dispensers (e.g., Echo), oligonucleotide synthesizers, robotic arms, Tecan instruments)
* Experience automating in vitro pharmacology and chemistry workflows.
* Strong method development and qualification skills, with a focus on reproducibility.
* Demonstrated ability to work directly with scientific users to gather requirements and support adoption.
* Experience with schedulers and end-to-end lab orchestration.
* Experience integrating automation with ELN/LIMS, such as Benchling.
* Experience with automated sample management systems.
* Proficiency in scripting or programming for automation.
* Experience using LLM-based coding tools or agentic assistants to accelerate method development, scripting, or systems integration.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to build durable working relationships with scientific users.

jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!  
  
About the Role:  
As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance in our fulfillment centers by providing proactive controls automation and technical support. Your expertise will be essential in troubleshooting complex control systems, analyzing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You'll mentor junior engineers and lead cross-functional teams to optimize material handling equipment (MHE) systems, implement innovative projects, and develop system design improvements to enhance site throughput. You'll work with state-of-the-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and SCADA devices and programs. Through your technical leadership and design optimization efforts, you'll directly contribute to ensuring our customers receive their orders with Amazon's signature speed and accuracy while building team capabilities and driving operational excellence.  
  
What Do We Offer?  
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

* You will apply Subject Matter Expertise (SME) on troubleshooting and dive deeps for engineering issues, supporting automation engineers to investigate the root cause and planning actions to eliminate/mitigate the downtime of critical assets
* You will collaborate with building Operations, Operations Engineering teams, FC Start-up Team, AFT Software teams, ACES team, and Safety to support MHE systems optimization and project implementation
* You will understand, maintain and troubleshoot material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers and industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
* You will monitor MHE metrics and partner with maintenance/operations to address system performance issues and provide analysis across all operations
* You will provide escalation support to automation engineers, during and after business hours, troubleshooting locally and remotely, to ensure that all hardware or controls software within the building is repaired on time
* You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 4+ years of PLC programming or automation engineering experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
* 4+ years of process or production environment related PLC-controlled automation and issue diagnosis experience
* 4+ years of robotics work cells and control systems experience
* 4+ years of Siemens, Allen-Bradley or Codesys Ladder Logic and structure programming experience
* 4+ years of electrical theory, robotics, controls components, and automated equipment experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent
* Master's degree, or Six Sigma Black Belt certification
* Experience leading controls in manufacturing or complex industrial environments
* Experience identifying, maintaining, troubleshooting, and modifying Motor Controls including motor starters, Variable Frequency Drives, DC drives, and standard electrical components
* Experience interpreting and modifying mechanical and electrical drawings

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave.
